name: Cozy Cone Vanilla Soft-Serve Ice Cream Cone
whyItWorks: Soft-serve dairy mix contains high levels of unbound lactose and emulsifiers that can trigger bloating, painful gas, and rapid transit in lactose-intolerant IBD patients.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Lactose Warning: Order in a cup rather than a crunchy cone, take a lactase pill, or opt for dairy-free frozen fruit snacks.
